item.title: CVE-2026-129998 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.3
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.3 | MaxKB is an open-source AI assistant for enterprise. Prior to 2.10.7-lts, custom Tool Init Param definitions accept attacker-controlled props_info.rules[].validator strings through POST /admin/api/workspace/{workspace_id}/tool and PUT /admin/api/workspace/{workspace_id}/tool/{tool_id}, store them without restriction, and pass them to eval() when the parameter form renders. An authenticated user with the default USER workspace role can store JavaScript and trigger execution by opening the tool's Debug screen before entering or submitting a parameter value. The same Init Param form is exposed to accounts with edit permission on the tool, but execution by a different account was not independently verified. The confirmed script runs in the MaxKB origin; access to another user's bearer token and authenticated account authority is plausible only if that user renders the malicious form. This issue is fixed in version 2.10.7-lts.

item.title: CVE-2026-134035 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.0: 7.8
item.description:
Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.0: 7.8 | Krita JC2 File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Krita. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
The issue results from the use of a vulnerable version of openjpeg. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-28646.

item.title: CVE-2026-134044 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.0: 5.5
item.description:
Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.0: 5.5 | Open Robotics ROS 2 sros2 load_policy XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Open Robotics ROS 2. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.
The specific flaw exists within the parsing of policy XML files. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-32121.

item.title: CVE-2026-54023 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. From 0.8.5 until 0.8.6, GET /api/user in api/server/controllers/UserController.js getUserController serializes federatedTokens and tokenset to the authenticated browser because an earlier response-sanitization fix was not applied to this endpoint. Browser-context script can obtain OAuth access, ID, and refresh credentials that were intended to remain server-side. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

item.title: CVE-2026-54031 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.3
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.3 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.8, packages/api/src/mcp/oauth/handler.ts createOAuthFetch validates only the initial destination for MCP OAuth discovery, registration, token, refresh, and revocation requests, then uses redirect-following fetch behavior without validating each redirect target. An attacker who can initiate MCP OAuth against a controlled endpoint can redirect server requests to internal or private addresses, reaching services that the initial SSRF checks should block. The separate MCP transport path already validates redirects and is not affected. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.8.

item.title: CVE-2026-54032 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.1 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.6, client/src/components/Chat/Input/MCPConfigDialog.tsx renders the remote MCP details.description value through dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitization, allowing a malicious MCP server to execute script when a user opens the configuration dialog. The secondary client/src/components/Banners/Banner.tsx sink similarly renders administrator-controlled banner.message HTML without sanitization for all users. Script execution occurs in the LibreChat browser origin and can expose browser-context data or alter displayed content. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

item.title: CVE-2026-54039 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 8.1 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. From 0.7.0 until 0.8.6, when local registration is enabled and at least one social provider is configured, POST /api/auth/register passes an unparsed request object into api/server/services/AuthService.js, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to persist a forged provider value for a known victim email. The api/strategies/socialLogin.js email-fallback path then accepts the planted record when the victim signs in because it compares the stored provider name without requiring the provider subject identifier. The victim OAuth session and the attacker local-password session become bound to the same user record, giving the attacker persistent read and write access to data created by the victim. The first-user administrator role is an additional conditional impact only on a fresh deployment. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

item.title: CVE-2026-54041 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 3.1
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 3.1 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.6, the POST /api/auth/login local-login validation path in api/strategies/localStrategy.js logs req.body, including the submitted plaintext password, during a Zod validation failure. The standard browser form validation makes this path less likely through the normal interface, but a direct invalid login request can reach it, and the logging formatter does not redact the password stored in metadata. A principal with access to application stdout, error logs, or journal output can recover the submitted credential. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.6.

item.title: CVE-2026-54042 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.8 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, POST /api/auth/2fa/verify-temp in api/server/routes/auth.js calls verify2FAWithTempToken and accepts repeated TOTP or backup-code guesses without a dedicated attempt limiter. An attacker must first possess valid primary credentials and a valid five-minute temp token, but can then make repeated second-factor attempts and obtain a full session if a valid code is guessed. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

item.title: CVE-2026-54043 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.3
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.3 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, packages/data-schemas/src/methods/file.ts updateFileUsage accepts chat attachment files[].file_id values without restricting the lookup to the authenticated owner. An authenticated attacker who obtains another user's file identifier, including through GET /api/share/{shareId} for a shared conversation, can attach that file to a chat, causing extracted document text to enter the model context. The same operation can remove expiration metadata from the victim file. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

item.title: CVE-2026-54044 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.7
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.7 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, POST /api/agents/actions/:agent_id in api/server/routes/agents/actions.js loads an existing action with owner credentials and merges editor-controlled metadata.domain and metadata.raw_spec while preserving metadata.api_key and related OAuth client secrets. A collaborator with EDIT permission can repoint an action to an attacker-controlled host, and a later tool invocation decrypts and sends the retained owner credential to that destination. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

item.title: CVE-2026-54045 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 6.5 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, POST /api/auth/requestPasswordReset calls deleteTokens by user ID before creating a reset token, while password-reset and email-verification records in packages/data-schemas/src/methods/token.ts have no populated flow type. When password reset is enabled and email verification is enforced, an unauthenticated attacker who knows a target email can repeatedly delete pending verification tokens and prevent account verification until the unverified account expires. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.

item.title: CVE-2026-54046 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3
item.description: Friday 20 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.3 | LibreChat is an enhanced ChatGPT clone that supports multiple AI providers. Prior to 0.8.7, unauthenticated POST /api/user/verify requests in api/server/routes/user.js call api/server/services/AuthService.js verifyEmail and return distinct responses for unknown, verified, and unverified email addresses and the route lacks request throttling. A remote attacker can submit candidate addresses with invalid tokens to enumerate registered accounts and verification state, supporting targeted phishing or credential attacks. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.7.
